must_have_properties: Command/address shall be transferred on a 7-bit CA bus (CA[6:0]) at double data rate, referenced to the quarter-speed master clock CK; a command occupies two CA transfers (rising CK edge + falling CK edge).
A full-speed differential Write Clock (WCK) at 4x the CK rate shall be used for data, enabled only when a transfer is imminent.
During reads the DRAM shall drive a full-speed differential Read Strobe (RDQS) edge-aligned with the read data.
Before any high-speed read/write the controller shall perform a WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS / WS_RD / WS_WR carried by the CAS command) to lock the DRAM's internal WCK to CK.
Opening a row shall require two Activate commands (Activate-1 then Activate-2).
LPDDR5 shall NOT use a CKE pin; low-power entry shall be a CA command that lasts until CS next goes high.
The device shall provide 16 banks organizable as four bank groups of four banks (BG mode), 16 flat banks (16B), or 8 banks (8B).
Prefetch shall be 16n (not doubled relative to LPDDR4); default burst length shall be 16 (BL16) with a double-length 32 (BL32) supported.
Data transfer rate shall be up to 6400 Mbit/s per pin (LPDDR5); up to 8533 Mbit/s for LPDDR5X (JESD209-5B/5X).
VDDQ shall be 0.5 V; core supplies VDD1 and VDD2H/VDD2L shall be provided; DVFSC selects VDD2H/VDD2L per frequency set point.
Read Link ECC and Write Link ECC (16-bit) and Data Bus Inversion (DBI, on DMI) shall be supported and configured consistently between controller and DRAM.
Refresh shall support all-bank (REFab) and per-bank (REFpb round-robin) modes; tREFI / tRFCab / tRFCpb shall be honoured; Adaptive Refresh Management (RFM) shall be supported per JESD209-5B.
Bank-group timing (tCCD_L / tRRD_L same-group; tCCD_S / tRRD_S different-group) and tFAW shall be honoured.
Read data shall appear at the programmed Read Latency; write data shall be accepted at the programmed Write Latency (Set A / Set B).
Reference voltages Vref(ca) / Vref(dq) and DFE / equalization settings shall be valid for the active frequency set point.
Deep Sleep Mode (DSE) shall be supported; exit shall require the full initialization sequence.
must_not_have_properties: A high-speed read or write shall not be issued without a prior WCK2CK synchronization (WCK is otherwise disabled).
The CAS command shall not be treated as a column-selecting command — in LPDDR5 it precedes the read/write and synchronizes WCK.
A CKE pin shall not be relied upon — LPDDR5 has none.
VDDQ shall not be driven above 0.5 V.
Writes shall not start at a non-multiple-of-16 column address (B0-B3 must be zero for writes; reads may use a non-zero B3).
Traffic shall not resume after deep-sleep exit without re-running the full initialization (ZQ + WCK2CK + training).
Mismatched Read/Write Link-ECC or DBI configuration between controller and DRAM shall not be used (silent data corruption).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Read/Write issued while WCK is disabled / not phase-locked — data timing undefined.
Controller treats LPDDR5 CAS like LPDDR4 CAS-2 — wrong addressing / timing.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: Column start not multiple-of-16 on write
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Write with non-zero B0-B3 — burst start mis-aligned.
Refresh scheduler bug / extended low-power without REF — cell data may be lost; no protocol flag.
tCCD_L / tRRD_L not honoured for same-group accesses — DRAM behaviour undefined.
IO driven above 0.5 V — device stress / damage.
Controller and DRAM configured differently — silent data corruption.
Frequency-set-point change without ZQ/WCK2CK/read/write retraining — read/write errors.
Resuming traffic immediately after DSM exit — undefined behaviour.

fields.min_clock_constraint: Operating data rate is set by the frequency set point: LPDDR5 up to 6400 Mbps (WCK 3200 MHz, CK 800 MHz); LPDDR5X up to 8533 Mbps (WCK 4266 MHz, CK 1066 MHz). The quarter-speed CK and 4:1 WCK:CK ratio must be maintained; WCK is enabled only when a transfer is imminent.
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: Asserting RESET_n LOW returns the device to its reset state — banks closed, mode registers cleared (must be re-programmed), outputs Hi-Z. After RESET_n rises, the initialization sequence (supply ramp with VDDQ=0.5 V, CK start, mode-register programming, ZQ calibration, initial WCK2CK synchronization, read/write training) must complete before normal operation. Deep-sleep exit also requires the full initialization sequence.
